section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.description: Welcome to Mielya Glass Ltd. Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect the personal information you provide when you contact us or submit a review through our website.

section2.intro: We only collect the information you voluntarily provide through our contact form or review form, which may include:
items: Your email address or phone number
The content of your message or review
section2.outro: We do not use cookies, tracking tools, or analytics.

section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
section3.intro: We use this information only to:
items: Respond to your inquiry or message
Publish or manage your review (if you choose to leave one)
Improve our services and communication with customers

section4.title: 4. Data Storage and Acces
section4.description: All messages and reviews are stored securely and are accessible only authorized company personnel. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with any third party.

section5.title: 5. Retention and Deletion
section5.description: Messages and reviews are kept for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes above. You may request deletion or correction of your information at any time by emailing us at: glassmilya@gmail.com

section6.title: 6. Data Security
section6.description: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

section7.title: 7. Your Rights
items: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Ask us to delete or update your information.
Withdraw your consent to publish your review at any time.
section7.outro: To exercise these rights, contact us at glassmielya@gmail.com.

section8.title: 8. Updates to this Policy
section8.description: We may update this policy periodically. Updates will be published on this page with the revised date.
